Liberal Arts and Sciences

Erasmus University College, Erasmus University Rotterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Erasmus University College offers a Liberal Arts and Sciences degree with an academic core, a declared major, research and elective study across humanities, social sciences, life sciences and economics. Its Sustainability major connects environmental, social, economic and historical inquiry.

A complete UCR comparison is withheld while the published cohort requirements remain inconsistent. The UCR study possibilities have been preserved for reassessment; this is not a judgment that UCR offers no suitable programme.

Academic year: 2026-2027

External pathway: Published Sustainability major; 2025 entrant cohort

The identified components account for 175 EC. The 2025 entrant catalogue states a 45-EC core but lists only 40 EC, while the current major applies to that cohort. Official clarification of the remaining 5 EC and the applicable graduation rules is required. This is an incomplete curriculum, not a certified degree plan.
